title: Transport one K-flat coordinate presentation to compatible target opens
statement: Let f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S and g':X'→X form a cartesian square [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], and suppose derived categories exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let K,K',φ:L(g')*K→K' and any coordinate presentation c for φ be given [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let V⊆S, V'⊆S' with V'⊆g⁻¹V, U=f⁻¹V, U'=f'⁻¹V', and j:U'→U with j≫U.ι=U'.ι≫g'. Suppose j,f'|V',f|V,g|V' is cartesian. Form the exact restrictions K0,K0' and canonical coefficient φ0 [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data]. There exists a coordinate presentation d for φ0 such that for every z∈U' and integer i, the stalk comparison of d in the restricted square is invertible if and only if the stalk comparison of c in the original square at the image of z is invertible. No original stalk condition is assumed.

proof.text: Restrict c.P and c.N termwise to U,U'. K-flat open restriction preserves c.P's K-flatness. Transport c.e,c.e' through exact localization. The underived pullback composition comparison, open-pullback adjunction comparison and pinned left-derived counit factorization identify the restriction of c.t with a representing map for the constructed φ0. The counit is invertible on the restricted K-flat complex, yielding coordinates d.

At z∈U', use the actual open-immersion stalk maps to identify the four local rings and the stalk complexes. Their compatibility with morphism stalk maps identifies the tensor-product algebra and tensorMap. The localized tensor comparison, tensorStalkIso and homology of the restricted representing map commute with these identifications. Hence the two stalk comparisons are conjugate through isomorphisms, proving the equivalence of invertibility. This is the termwise calculation of equation-bc and does not use the universally quantified stalk condition.

theorem singleComplexOpen_coordinates_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' K K' φ)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV')) :
    let K₀ := (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K
    let K₀' := (schemeOpenRestriction X' (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V')).mapDerivedCategory.obj K'
    let φ₀ := singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient g' K K' φ
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj
    ∃ d : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates j K₀ K₀' φ₀,
      ∀ (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) (i : ℤ),
        IsIso (SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison
          (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ d z i) ↔
        IsIso (SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison f f' g g' sq c z.val i)
